title: porophyllum ellipticum var. ruderale
intro: Porophyllum ellipticum var. ruderale, commonly known as Cuernillo or Mountain Cuernillo, is a plant species native to the mountainous regions of Mexico. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering potential health benefits such as reducing inflammation, improving digestion, and alleviating respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which exhibit anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. Further research is needed to fully understand the effects of Porophyllum ellipticum var. ruderale on human health, but it shows promise as a natural remedy for various health conditions.
